en: "I'm here, Ymir."
"Sorry to keep you waiting, Ymir."
"I've come to settle things with you."
"Hello. You did well to make it back."
"My, that was a truly fascinating fight.{n} For defectives, you humans do show{n} power beyond calculation."
"The wavering of your emotions was{n} truly amusing as well."
"Yours especially, {hero:6}."
"When you slaughtered your former{n} friend, joy, too, lay hidden deep in{n} your feelings. Not that you noticed..."
"It was the feeling of revenge fulfilled."
"There I saw the essence of humans."
"A creature self-centered to the last."
"At the same time, the surface mind{n} holds stirrings of emotion that act as{n} sophistry, hiding that from yourself."
"Yours especially, {name:6}."
"When you slaughtered your former{n} husband, release, too, lay hidden deep{n} in your feelings. Not that you noticed..."
"It was the joy of escaping your bonds."
"There I saw the essence of humans."
"A creature bound by its own rules."
"Yet the surface and deep minds admit{n} and deny it at once. Self-contradiction{n} is the very premise of being human."
"The human mind is truly chaos."
"Hating bonds, yet seeking bonds. So you{n} built up a being called god, as the{n} ultimate rule above every law."
"You humans often say it, do you not?{n} That god is always watching us{n} from the heavens."
"No one is able to deceive the self.{n} God and the self are one and the same.{n} God is a concept that binds the self."
"The trouble is, the essence of humans{n} always lies in the individual: that is,{n} in satisfying one's own desires, so..."
"Passing desire off as the will of god,{n} you have repeated many wars and{n} slaughtered many of your own kind..."
"It need not even be god."
"Government, race, liberation,{n} morals, progress, self-defense."
"Only the words have changed. Like god,{n} they are spells for satisfying{n} your own desires."
"Ornaments for desire,{n} patched together with lies."
"A beast does not seek extra prey{n} for the sake of tomorrow, or the day{n} after tomorrow..."
"But you humans picked up your petty{n} cleverness, and so you came to carry{n} a constant dread of the future."
"You look to complex systems to save{n} you, but the complexity breeds new{n} dread. And that leads to new deceit."
"You had better give up."
"This thing you made and call society{n} collapsed long ago, after all."
"So what if it did?"
"So what are you saying?"
"So I am starting over from scratch."
"You are failures, when all is said.{n} Only your cleverness swelled to excess;{n} your souls' evolution has not kept up."
"Pests? Parasites?"
"Nothing so mild as that. You are{n} less than that. Lower than that:{n} an irregularity among living things."
"I mean to make a new vessel for souls:{n} a creature without petty cleverness,{n} full of the harmony of living things."
"I gathered a great deal of data on{n} this island, you see. The work looks to{n} be done sooner than I expected."
"But before that..."
"I must clear away what is in the way."
"The island of steel is shaking!?"
"You bastard, what did you do!?{n} What the hell are you starting!?"
"I told you, did I not?{n} I am clearing away what is in the way."
"I removed the experimental facilities{n} that made up the island."
"This too is thanks to you, for undoing{n} the seal of those meddlers,{n} the Twelve Gods."
"Let me thank you once again."
"After this, I must also neatly clear{n} away the creatures of the Europea{n} continent, lest they get in my way."
"That's as far as you go, Ymir."
"Why is that?"
"Because I'm gonna kill you dead."
"Oh? A human, kill a god?"
"God or devil, I couldn't care less.{n} I hate you, so I'm killing you.{n} That's all."
"Ahaha, what very human reasoning.{n} If you dislike someone, kill them.{n} That, too, is an essence of human malice."
"I've had it with worthless reasoning."
"Quibbles and justifications? Leave{n} those to some theology nut{n} or book-learning fool."
"I'm here, alive, just like this!"
"I'm pissed off at you!"
"So I'll kill you dead!"
"To hell with reasons!"
"You had better not."
"And here I had meant to keep the{n} two of you alive, as samples{n} in the new world."
"As descendants of a savage race."
"Descendants of a savage race, Ymir?{n} Isn't that you? Spawn of those{n} shitheads called the Ancient Gods!"
"Good grief. How tiresome."
"Very well. Before I erase the other{n} creatures from this world, I have{n} decided to erase you first."
"Go ahead and try!"
"If you can!"
"Stop this, Ymir."
"Why?"
"If you don't stop, I will defeat you."
"Oh? A human will defeat a god?"
"Human or god, it doesn't matter!"
"To take the lives of the living as you{n} please... not even a god has{n} any such right!"
"Why? I do not quite follow.{n} The owner is breaking what he owns.{n} So why do you complain?"
"Because life belongs to no one!"
"Ahaha, what a sham love-for-all.{n} Does a human life outweigh the earth?{n} I can only think you are insane."
"Life is overflowing everywhere.{n} Making a machine is harder than{n} making a life."
"For me, that is."
"You are not us."
"If you kill me for that reason,{n} then you are savage slaughterers."
"Yes. The same as you."
"Good grief. How tiresome."
"Very well. Before I erase the other{n} creatures from this world, I have{n} decided to erase you first."
"You can't erase us!"
"Oh?"
"Because we're going to win!"
"Good grief. This is a fine chance, so{n} I will show you just a little of the{n} power of the new vessel I made."
"The power of the vessel for my soul."
"This is...?"
"Is it... a Machine Man...?"
"This thing's a lot worse than that!"
"Yes, this vessel is rather good too."
"I bundled human living tissue and{n} applied the Machine Men's regeneration.{n} It seems to run better than I expected."
"Now then, time to warm up, I suppose."
"Well, that is about it, I suppose?"
"The cells only last 30,000 years or{n} so, but for something made to kill{n} time, I think it came out rather well."
"Shall we begin, then?"
"Damn right, Ymir!"
"I'll show you just what humanity can{n} do, wounded beast that it is!"
"Of course, Ymir!"
"The power of the humans you call{n} failures: now I will show it to you!"
"God or devil, it's a thing with form!{n} So there's no way it can't{n} be broken!"
"That is the way of the world!"
"Let's smash it with our own hands!"
"Please, everyone! Lend me your{n} strength just a little longer!"
"Yeah, I'm seeing this to the end now!{n} God or whatever, getting killed on{n} someone's whim doesn't sit right!"
"Let's begin! The final battle!"
"Lt. {hero:6}, sir, by your side{n} I'd die content. Let's fight{n} until this life runs out!"
"Let's go, Lt. {hero:6}, sir!{n} A proud soldier of Romulus never{n} deserts in the face of the enemy!"
"What we believe in is the god in our{n} hearts! That thing is no god! It is evil{n} incarnate, with a heart full of evil!"
"If it's come to this, I shall fight!{n} Li'l Tethys doesn't want to die, so{n} she'll fight to the death, yes indeed!"
"Heh heh, this recalls a hundred years{n} ago. Those thrilling days of war when{n} I raced along with a man like the wind."
"I'm a professor, you know!{n} Fighting's not my thing!"
"But I'll fight alongside you!{n} I can't go getting killed before I{n} complete the ultimate Item Theory!"
"Prince {hero:6}, I'll fight with all{n} I've got! It's my last chance to pay{n} you back for taking me in!"
"You are certain to prevail, {name:6}.{n} With the power of a true sacred knight{n} who fought through this isle of chaos!"
"I will now release my limiter.{n} And I will fight by my own will.{n} Even if it means killing a Creator!"
"Sir {hero:6}, Lady {name:6}."
"I am truly glad I met you both.{n} I was able to find my own self.{n} Now I shall repay that debt."
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!{n} So this is the last fight on this{n} island of steel, huh, {hero:6}!"
"Then let's go out with a bang!{n} I'll give this Ymir or whatever a{n} taste of my heavy MG's firepower!"
"My name is... J... and it means...{n} ...J for... Judgment...{n} I now pass... judgment on Ymir."
"The death penalty..."
"Magic, is it..."
"That, too, was first made in our age."
"We remade space itself for convenience,{n} fixed elements nature never made, and{n} built remote control, powerless engines."
"The magic you use is a remnant of that."
"You do not grasp the root truth, yet{n} you use anything that can be used.{n} That is a bad habit of you humans."
"Like the Void ore we were producing:{n} you dug it up without leave and made{n} weapons you call Voids."
"Special moves, is it..."
"Among humans, then only just completed,{n} we picked the finest specimens and by{n} gene work raised them as weapons, but..."
"It seems that ability still lingers,{n} just a little, in some humans."
"It is odd when you think about it, no?"
"That creatures who can run faster{n} than sound or fell a dragon{n} bare-handed should exist at all..."
"That is right, {hero:6}."
"That is right, {name:6}."
"What you call the bloodline of Knights{n} is a special genetic factor, passed on by{n} those we modified most heavily then..."
"I am sorry for you humans, but the{n} energy I can wield is of another order.{n} You will see when you see this move."
"This is the power of a god."
"Kh! Guess I've gotta hand it to you.{n} You don't call yourself a god{n} for nothing!"
"Don't give up, Prince {hero:6}!{n} The prince I know would never{n} give up, no matter what!"
"C'mon, c'mon! What's wrong, {hero:6}!?{n} Whining ain't like you at all!"
"Do not falter, Mr. {hero:6}.{n} You can do it. You can master{n} the Bounty Sword."
"Yes, I know it to be so."
"The Bounty Sword is a god-slaying{n} blade. A true knight should be able{n} to draw out its power without limit."
"What're you doing, {hero:6}!"
"I, the Professor, am putting my faith{n} in you! So live up to it and fight{n} with some snaaap, will you!?"
"Damage to the enemy is confirmed.{n} It is an entity with physical form.{n} It is not beyond our reach."
"Do not let up the attack, {hero:6}.{n} Keep this pace and crush it in one push."
"What is the matter, Mr. {hero:6}!?"
"Will it strongly in your heart: that{n} you wish to win. Then a strong flow of{n} ki shall grant you boundless power."
"We cannot lose, not ever! You can win,{n} Mr. {hero:6}! Li'l Tethys firmly{n} believes it, yes indeed!"
"What's wrong, Lt. {hero:6}, sir!?{n} Your orders, like always! And{n} let's win, like we always do!"
"Not yet, Lt. {hero:6}, sir!{n} We haven't lost! The fight{n} is only starting, sir!"
"Mr. {hero:6}, please hold on!{n} Only you, who have known an evil{n} heart, can defeat true evil!"
"In power alone, it truly is a god!{n} Our attacks aren't working!?"
"Do not lose heart, {name:6}.{n} Believe in your own strength.{n} Then you shall never be defeated."
"Do not... worry... {name:6}...{n} ...You will... not die.{n} I will... protect you to the end..."
"Do not falter, Miss {name:6}.{n} You can do it. You can master{n} the Bounty Sword."
"Yes, I know it to be so."
"The Bounty Sword is a god-slaying{n} blade. A true knight should be able{n} to draw out its power without limit."
"What're you doing, {name:6}!"
"I, the Professor, am giving it my all!{n} So take some responsibility and{n} fight with some snaaap, will you!?"
"Damage to the enemy is confirmed.{n} It is an entity with physical form.{n} It is not beyond our reach."
"Do not let up the attack, {name:6}.{n} Keep this pace and crush it in one push."
"What is the matter, Lady {name:6}!?"
"Will it strongly in your heart: that{n} you wish to win. Then a strong flow of{n} ki shall grant you boundless power."
"We cannot lose, not ever! You can win,{n} Miss {name:6}! Li'l Tethys firmly{n} believes it, yes indeed!"
"I see..."
"So that is how a mere human{n} managed to come this far."
"Naturally, you would not have noticed.{n} That since before you were born, the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods were directing it."
"And that even your life since then{n} was as the Zodiac Twelve Gods intended."
"Your father's fall and death. Your{n} knight's power waking. Special Service.{n} Betrayal by your one trusted friend..."
"All of it went just as scripted."
"The writers: the Zodiac Twelve Gods...{n} The aim: to seal and erase me...{n} The one made to act it out: you..."
"You are no agent of the gods.{n} You are merely the gods' puppet!"
"What a load of crap..."
"I live by my own will. I've walked{n} my life by my own will. No god's{n} will has any part in it."
"No, you are being kept alive.{n} As a pawn to achieve an end, the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods keep you alive."
"No... it can't be..."
"I live by my own strength.{n} Nobody is keeping me alive..."
"If you do not believe it, very well."
"Either way, you will die. Never{n} noticing that you are kept alive,{n} you will die like worms."
"What did you say?"
"Your birth as the island chief's{n} daughter. Meeting your husband-to-be as{n} a child. His never returning from here."
"All of it went just as scripted."
"The writers: the Zodiac Twelve Gods...{n} The aim: to seal and erase me...{n} The one made to act it out: you..."
"You are no agent of the gods.{n} You are merely the gods' puppet!"
"It can't be..."
"That is impossible! We live by{n} our own strength! It has nothing{n} to do with the will of any god!"
"Everyone is living with all their{n} might, by their own strength!"
"No, you are being kept alive.{n} As a pawn to achieve an end, the{n} Zodiac Twelve Gods keep you alive."
"That isn't true..."
"I... We...{n} Even if we have to crawl, we'll{n} go on living by our own will!"
"If you do not believe it, very well."
"Either way, you will die. Never{n} noticing that you are kept alive,{n} you will die like worms."
"What do you mean?"
"This is what I mean..."
"Is he... dead...?"
"No, he has only lost his form.{n} Most likely in search of the{n} next vessel for his soul."
"Then we can't beat him? Not even{n} a knight's techniques can cut{n} through a soul!?"
"This is my soul..."
"That which forms the root of what{n} makes me myself..."
"And after all my experiments on this{n} island, the final vessel I found at{n} last, the one that promises eternity..."
"This is no ordinary earthquake!?"
"The whole planet... is quaking...?"
"The main body of the island of steel:{n} that is, the pillar of steel you now{n} stand on. Do you see its true meaning?"
"It is a catheter stuck into the earth.{n} Or a penis inserted into the mother{n} body called earth, to send out sperm."
"To merge my soul with the world."
"Don't tell me you...!?"
"You don't mean that you...!?"
"Yes. The finest vessel I found is{n} this world itself. Merged with the{n} world, I become a true god."
"My end is the world's end.{n} The world's end is my end.{n} That is eternity: a truly eternal body."
"My will is the world's will.{n} The world's will is my will.{n} That is infinity: a truly infinite mind."
"Give up, servants of the Zodiac{n} Twelve Gods."
"No technique and no weapon can wound{n} the world itself. For you, too,{n} are a part of the world."
"It begins: the new order of the world."
"Exactly as I wish it."
"Is this... Ymir's final form?"
"This is... Ymir's true body...!?"
"Yes. Do you know what this is?"
"I have been thinking all this time."
"This world is already beyond saving.{n} Over the vast gulf of time, the blood of{n} worthless creatures stained it too far."
"So I am remaking it."
"I am an egg."
"An egg that holds a cosmos within."
"The Cosmic Egg."
"I will erase this utterly stained{n} world and start over once more{n} from scratch."
"A new cosmos, a new earth, new land.{n} And new humans to live there. The world{n} is reborn and marks a new time."
"For that, I remade myself."
"I am the world's Creator, master of{n} all things. On the new earth, this{n} time, I will become a real god."
"So this world is finished."
"Cut the crap, Ymir!{n} Life has no reset!"
"All we can do is live in the now!"
"Even if life is hard and steep,{n} all we can do is grit our teeth{n} and move forward bit by bit!"
"That's what being human is!"
"You deny the way humans live!{n} You insult us!{n} So you're our enemy!"
"I feel sorry for you, Ymir."
"Life can never be done over.{n} That's exactly why we live each{n} day with all our might."
"You, who can be reborn at any time,{n} will never be able to understand{n} that earnest human way of living..."
"Yes, never in all eternity!"
"You and we are different creatures.{n} We are hostile lives, with{n} interests that clash."
"So we will kill you!"
"Do you intend to destroy the{n} new cosmos that is to be born?"
"Too bad for you, Ymir!"
"The lot of us...!"
"The world just as it is...!"
"This filthy world...!"
"We love it well enough already!"
"We don't need any new world!"
"So it was pointless to speak{n} to vulgar life forms."
"I will speak to you no more."
"I will simply obliterate you."
"For the new world about to be born."
"This is the final battle!{n} Redeploy! Let's go!"
"It's the final battle, everyone!{n} Please regroup!"
"I've got nothing more to say!{n} We're making this the last battle!{n} Trust me with your lives!"
"I have nothing more to say!{n} This is the last battle! Everyone,{n} your lives are in my hands!"
"Huh?"
"What happened, I wonder?"
"It broke?"
"The cosmic egg inside me broke?"
"The new world is gone?"
"Huh?"
"But I was a god?"
"Why am I being beaten, I wonder?"
"You're dead, Ymir."
"No. I killed you."
"Or is it your first time? Dying?"
"You are dead, Ymir."
"I killed you with these hands."
"Is it your first time? Dying?"
"Dead...?"
"Does dying mean vanishing?"
"No. I do not want to vanish."
"I do not want to vanish at all."
"But I am a god, am I not?"
"Gods die the same as people, Ymir.{n} The only one that never really dies{n} is the imagined god in people's hearts."
"Yes, gods die the same as people.{n} The only one that never dies is the{n} true god we hold in our hearts."
"Die?"
"But I do not... want to die..."
"Like a human..."
"Why... must I... die..."
"But... my will... surely...{n} survived... somewhere in the world."
"My kind... someday... will fulfill..."
"it... for me... I am su..."
"Ah"
"What's happeniiing!?"
"Ymir died and the island started to{n} shake. Most likely this island of{n} steel was Ymir's body itself."
"So then?"
"Let's get out of here, {name:6}!"
"Yes, Mr. {hero:6}!"
"Whaaat!?"
"Oh myyyyyyyy!?"
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
